research_result.description: Gladly is a customer service and helpdesk platform that provides conversation-centered support, REST APIs, and Lookup APIs to manage agent, conversation, answer, and customer data.
research_result.credential_requirements: To access the API, a Gladly Administrator must assign the API User permission to a designated user account. Once granted, an API token can be generated under Settings > API Tokens. API calls use Basic Authentication with the agent's email address as the username and the API token as the password. Access to a sandbox environment requires contacting a Gladly CSM or Support.

evidence.claim: Gladly uses token-based Basic Authentication requiring an agent email and API token.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.

evidence.claim: Gladly provides a REST API to integrate and interact with platform data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can integrate easily with Gladly by calling Gladly's REST API and implementing the Lookup API to provide data from your own services.

evidence.claim: Sandbox environments and initial account access are gated and require contacting Gladly support or CSM.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: If you do not have a sandbox environment and are interested in purchasing one, please contact your Gladly CSM or Gladly Support team.

evidence.claim: StackOne provides a third-party hosted Gladly MCP server with 65 actions.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Connect your AI agent to StackOne's Gladly MCP server and give it 65 MCP tools out of the box.
